_readme: TMP_009 spike — gen-side fix for the 'baked-in ground' problem via NAG (Normalized Attention Guidance, in-tree ComfyUI core node). Same Flux dev Q8 + dark_fantasy LoRA + sampler + sizes + seeds as homm3-flux-bush-biome-pack, but: (1) model routed to `flux1-dev-q8-tree-nag` whose workflow inserts NAGuidance between UnetLoaderGGUF and KSampler so the negative prompt biting works at CFG=1.0 on distilled Flux; (2) negative prompt HARDENED with no-ground/no-rocks/no-platform terms. Positive template kept at the ORIGINAL bush phrasing so the A/B isolates NAG's effect from a positive-prompt rewrite. 1 biome (abyss_chaos_rift) × 1 entry (alpine_dwarf_shrub_cluster) × 3 seeds → direct A/B with outputs/homm3-bundle/pass-full-001/homm3/bush/abyss_chaos_rift/bush/alpine_dwarf_shrub_cluster__1024_1024__s{101,202,303}.png.
